slots.title: End questionnaire — intervention, demographics, BAT, lifestyle
slots.introText: Almost done! Finally, we'd like a bit of background information on your life, and the state in which you arrived at our experiment.

explainerMap.Intervention program: People often encounter stressful situations in everyday life, but they are not always easy to manage effectively. As part of another study from our research team, we are offering you the opportunity to sign up for a brief online program after Lowlands designed to help you cope with everyday stress more effectively.
explainerMap.Mood scale: How do you feel currently? Please indicate which of the following terms best describes your mood at this moment?
explainerMap.Demographics & lifestyle: Almost done! Finally, we'd like a bit of background information on your life, and the state in which you arrived at our experiment.
explainerMap.Burnout Assessment Tool (BAT): Reflect on the following statements about how you typically feel at work/study.

questions.text: Participating in this program is attractive to me.
questions.stem: For five consecutive days, you will receive a short daily questionnaire. Here you will be asked to reflect on a stressful experience you have had, how you responded, and what you might do differently in the future. This may help you become more aware of how you respond to stress, recognise which strategies work well for you, and identify ways to respond more effectively in the future. At the end of the 5 day program, you will receive a summary of your reflections. You will then be guided through developing a personalised action plan for managing similar situations the following week or in the future. The online program will take place one week after Lowlands.
